items.title: Snap Soars 7% as Deutsche Bank Says Its Subscription Story Is “Better Than the Tape Suggests”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSnap shares rose 7% after Deutsche Bank kept its Buy rating and $8 target, saying investors underrate its subscriptions. Paid subscribers rose 77% to about 30 million last quarter, bringing in about three-quarters of Snap’s added revenue.
